_approach: Stripped amen-ghost breakdown: the kick is gone entirely and only the amen's low-velocity ghost-snare chatter and a soft ride wash remain, so the room to breathe is total; a single soft clap on the last beat of bar 2 cues the kick's return. Ref: Magnetic Magazine's note that 'the snare carries the groove' even when everything else drops out; KAN Samples' DnB arrangement guide on the drumless breakdown as an emotional reset.
